title: Assistant Manager – Product Adoption & Customer Success (B2B)
description:
Key Responsibilities

* **Product Demonstrations:** Conduct demonstrations for corporate and agency customers, explain platform features, and showcase relevant use cases.
* **Customer Onboarding:** Help customers understand the platform, complete registration, navigate workflows, and initiate their first project.
* **First-Project Activation:** Guide customers through their initial project and scoping process, ensuring they understand the steps involved.
* **Customer Engagement:** Follow up with customers who register but do not start a project, abandon a workflow, or need additional assistance.
* **Product Adoption:** Improve customer activation, engagement, scope completion, and repeat usage through structured onboarding and follow-ups.
* **Customer Success:** Identify challenges faced by users and help them use the platform more independently over time.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:** Work with Relationship Managers to support existing customers and coordinate with the Product team to communicate customer feedback and workflow challenges.
* **Performance Tracking:** Maintain customer activity records and track onboarding progress, activation, drop-offs, and repeat usage through CRM tools, spreadsheets, or dashboards.
* **Product Feedback:** Share recurring customer questions, usability issues, and suggestions with the Product team to help improve the platform experience.
* **Customer Reactivation:** Develop appropriate follow-up approaches to encourage inactive registered users to explore relevant platform features and use cases.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS Onboarding, Product Adoption, B2B Platform Support, Product Implementation, Customer Enablement, or a similar customer-facing technology role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience conducting product demonstrations, customer training, onboarding, or implementation sessions.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and explain software features in a simple, practical manner.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with CRM tools, spreadsheets, customer activity tracking, and basic conversion or funnel analysis.
* Ability to identify customer challenges and recommend practical ways to improve product usage.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* B2B SaaS platforms
* Customer Success or Customer Onboarding
* HRTech, MarTech, CRM, or enterprise software
* B2B marketplaces or digital platforms
* Product Implementation or Customer Enablement

Experience in the creative industry is not mandatory. The ability to learn a technology platform and help customers use it effectively is more important.

Understanding This Role

This is primarily a **Product Adoption and Customer Success role**, not a direct-sales or digital-marketing position.

The focus is on helping customers move from understanding the platform to actively using it, completing their first project, and returning for future requirements. Relationship Managers handle commercial negotiations and account relationships, while the Product team manages product development and roadmap decisions.

Why Join StudioIP?

* Work with a growing B2B creative technology platform.
* Collaborate directly with corporate customers, Relationship Managers, and the Product team.
* Contribute to improving customer experience and platform adoption.
* Help shape how businesses discover and use creative production services through technology.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who have experience in customer success, software onboarding, product adoption, or B2B platform implementation are encouraged to apply.

Please share your updated resume highlighting relevant customer-facing technology experience.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**About ETS:**

Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.

Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization, enabling lifelong learners to be future ready. We advance the science of measurement to build the benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment. We are committed to powering human progress by promoting skill proficiency, empowering upward mobility, and unlocking more opportunities for everyone, everywhere. title: Senior Manager, Service Operations
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ROLE MISSION**

Own the operational health, service outcomes and lifecycle execution of the Passenger Processing portfolio, ensuring reliable day-to-day operations while driving disciplined modernization across the full technology stack.

**PURPOSE**
-----------

The Head of Service Operations is the senior operational leader for the Passenger Processing portfolio. Reporting directly to the Director, Portfolio Service Operations - PAX, the role converts portfolio strategy and the Head of Service Operations Role Charter into consistent execution across global service operations, deployment and lifecycle activities.

The position leads an internationally distributed organization of approximately 40-50 people. Success therefore requires strong multicultural leadership, the ability to operate across regions and time zones, and confidence engaging senior stakeholders across SITA to resolve priorities, risks, dependencies and investment decisions.

**Portfolio Context and Scale**

* Lead service operations for a broad, mission-critical Passenger Processing portfolio supporting airport and airline operations across international environments.

* Manage a distributed organization of approximately 40-50 employees and leaders across multiple countries, cultures, technical disciplines and operating locations.

* Operate across application, platform, infrastructure, operating system, tooling, network and airport endpoint layers, with accountability for the operational outcome across the full stack.

* Engage extensively with senior stakeholders across Portfolio Service Operations, Product, Technology & Engineering, SRE, Service Architecture, DCO, PFS/field services, CSO/GEO teams, security, suppliers and customers.

* Balance 24x7 BAU service delivery with lifecycle modernization, operational technical-debt reduction, deployment demand and transformation priorities.

**Leadership Mandate**

* Provide visible leadership to managers, technical leads and operational specialists, creating one portfolio-wide Service Operations capability rather than separate product silos.

* Set clear accountability, priorities, performance expectations and decision rights across the organization.

* Build an inclusive, high-performance culture that values ownership, operational discipline, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.

* Develop succession, capability and workforce plans; coach leaders and specialists; and ensure resource capacity is aligned to portfolio risk and demand.

* Lead effectively across cultural and geographic boundaries, adapting communication and engagement while maintaining common standards and outcomes.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Operational BAU Performance and Service Outcomes**

* Own overall BAU operational performance across the Passenger Processing portfolio, ensuring services meet agreed SLA/SLO, availability, quality and customer commitments.

* Establish portfolio-wide performance governance, dashboards, operating reviews, escalation routes and corrective-action tracking.

* Ensure operational risks, service degradation, recurring failures and capacity constraints are visible, owned and addressed.

* Act as the senior escalation point for material service issues and remove cross-functional roadblocks to restore service and protect customers.

**2. IT Service Management Execution**

* Own the effectiveness and operational discipline of Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request and Work Order processes within the portfolio.

* Ensure major and critical incidents receive decisive leadership, effective cross-team coordination, timely stakeholder communication and structured follow-through.

* Drive backlog health, ageing reduction, update quality, closure discipline and prioritization across all operational queues.

* Ensure changes are risk-assessed, operationally ready, scheduled with appropriate controls and reviewed for outcome and learning.

* Maintain timely and predictable fulfilment of service requests and work orders, including governance of readiness, dependencies, throughput and delivery commitments.

**3. Operational Technical Debt and Lifecycle Management**

* Own and maintain the portfolio operational technical-debt register, ensuring risks are quantified, prioritized, funded, assigned and tracked to closure.

* Maintain a full-stack lifecycle view covering infrastructure, operating systems, databases, middleware, tooling, applications and airport endpoints.

* Drive supported-version compliance, patching, upgrades, maintenance and remediation plans; require explicit, time-bound exceptions where target standards cannot be met.

* Translate lifecycle and technical-debt exposure into clear operational, security, resilience, customer and financial impact for senior decision-makers.

* Coordinate with SRE, Service Architecture, Product and Technology & Engineering to determine which gaps are engineered out, modernized, automated or temporarily absorbed operationally.

**4. Deployment and Operational Readiness**

* Be accountable for portfolio deployment execution, including software rollout, patching, application upgrades and airport activation activities within the agreed operating model.

* Ensure work orders are planned, readiness-checked, prioritized and delivered within committed timelines and quality standards.

* Accept or reject services into operation against agreed Build-to-Run and readiness criteria, escalating unresolved risk where required.

* Ensure new and changed services have adequate support models, documentation, monitoring, skills, capacity, recovery procedures and lifecycle ownership before production acceptance.

Qualifications:

**Senior Stakeholder Engagement**

* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting to the Director and senior leadership on operational performance, major risks, customer impact, technical debt, lifecycle exposure and investment needs.

* Influence priorities across SITA where accountability is shared, ensuring decisions are translated into named owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

* Represent Passenger Processing Service Operations in executive reviews, portfolio governance, customer escalations, audit and risk forums, and transformation programmes.

* Create constructive challenge where delivery, product, architecture or engineering decisions introduce unacceptable operational risk or insufficient supportability.

**Performance Measures**

* SLA/SLO achievement, service availability, operational stability and reduction of customer-impacting incidents.

* Major incident response quality, MTTR improvement, RCA completion and sustained remediation of recurring causes.

* Problem, incident, service-request and work-order backlog health, ageing, throughput and delivery predictability.

* Change success, emergency-change control, deployment quality and reduction of change-related incidents.

* Lifecycle compliance, patch and version currency, reduction of unsupported technology and closure of operational technical debt.

* Build-to-Run readiness, successful transition into operations and completeness of support documentation, monitoring and ownership.

* Team capability, engagement, succession strength, cross-location collaboration and effective capacity utilization.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in complex technology service operations, including substantial leadership accountability in a global or multi-region environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading a sizeable, distributed and multicultural organization, ideally 40+ people through managers and technical leads.

* Proven ownership of operational performance across business-critical, high-availability services and complex customer environments.

* Strong experience across Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request, Work Order, deployment and service-lifecycle management.

* Demonstrated management of operational technical debt, lifecycle risk, patching, upgrades, platform currency and modernization programmes.

* Experience influencing senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders where outcomes depend on shared accountability rather than direct authority.

* Excellent record of leading major escalations, translating technical complexity into business impact, and driving durable corrective action.

**Knowledge and Skills**

**Strategic and operational leadership:** Portfolio operations; operating-model execution; governance; risk-based prioritization; financial and capacity awareness; transformation leadership. 2

**Service management:** Strong command of ITIL practices, SLA/SLO management, major incident governance, problem management, change control, request fulfilment and continual improvement.

**Technology lifecycle:** Practical understanding of infrastructure, OS, network, database, middleware, tooling, applications, monitoring, resilience, security and end-of-support risk.

**People leadership:** Leading through managers; multicultural team leadership; coaching; succession; performance expectations; conflict resolution; organizational change.

**Stakeholder influence:** Executive communication; negotiation; customer assurance; cross-functional decision-making; vendor and supplier engagement; clear escalation and decision framing.

**Data and execution discipline:** Operational metrics; dashboards; trend analysis; risk registers; action tracking; benefits realization; evidence-based decisions and measurable outcomes.

**Education and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Operations Management or a related discipline; equivalent senior operational experience may be considered.

* ITIL certification is strongly preferred. Lean Six Sigma, project/programme management, cloud, infrastructure, network, security or reliability qualifications are advantageous.

* Demonstrable leadership development and experience operating in international, customer-facing technology environments.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

**Flex-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*

title: Senior Analyst, Incident Management
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.

  


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Major Incident Leadership:** Establishes control rapidly, sets priorities, drives decisions and maintains momentum until stable service is verified.

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

**Problem Solving \& Judgement:** Synthesizes incomplete information, challenges assumptions and makes timely, risk\-informed decisions.

**Process Integration:** Connects incident learning to Problem, Change, Knowledge, Event, Service Level and Continual Improvement outcomes.

**Transformation \& Improvement:** Identifies systemic gaps and converts lessons into sustainable improvements, automation and improved ways of working.

**Stakeholder Leadership:** Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.

**Data \& Insight:** Uses operational metrics, trends and quality analysis to target improvements and demonstrate benefits.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Accountability and ownership
* Customer centricity
* Collaboration and inclusion
* Integrity and professional courage
* Agility and resilience
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Results orientation
* Learning mindset and continuous improvement
* Composure under pressure
* Attention to detail and quality

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
